Bagi maksud caj perkhidmatan penumpang—

(a) "Penumpang Asal-Destinasi" ertinya seseorang penumpang yang berlepas dari

suatu lapangan terbang di Malaysia yang bukan seorang penumpang Pindahan;

(b) "Penumpang Pindahan" ertinya mana-mana penumpang yang memegang

satu tiket yang dijadualkan untuk berlepas dari suatu lapangan terbang

di Malaysia dalam masa dua puluh empat jam dari masa ketibaan yang dijadualkan

baginya ke suatu lapangan terbang lain di Malaysia atau suatu negara lain selain

lapangan terbang dari mana penumpang tersebut berlepas—

(i) dalam sesuatu pesawat udara yang berlainan yang penumpang tersebut

tiba di lapangan terbang di Malaysia; atau

(ii) dalam pesawat udara yang sama yang penumpang tersebut tiba

di lapangan terbang di Malaysia tetapi dengan nombor penerbangan

yang berlainan;

yang dikendali oleh syarikat penerbangan yang sama atau berlainan.".

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION ACT 2015

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION (AVIATION SERVICES CHARGES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2024

of the Malaysian Aviation Commission Act 2015 [Act 771], the Commission makes the

following regulations:

For the purposes of passenger service charges—

(a) "Origin-Destination Passenger" means a passenger who departs from an airport

in Malaysia that is not a Transfer passenger;

(b) "Transfer Passenger" means any passenger who holds a single passenger ticket

that is scheduled to depart from an airport in Malaysia within twenty-four hours

of their scheduled time of arrival for another airport in Malaysia or another

country other than the airport from which they departed—

".

(i) on a different aircraft by which they arrived at the airport in Malaysia; or

(ii) on the same aircraft by which they arrived at the airport in Malaysia but

with a different flight number;

operated by the same or another airline.".
